resources.name: Morse potential parameters for Ni₃Al (Tsaregorodtsev et al., 1984)

access.notes: Published in: Fiz. Met. Metalloved. 58, 336–343 (1984). Pairwise Morse potentials for Ni₃Al including five coordination spheres.
Open-source MD code; any standard MD package with Morse potentials is acceptable; LAMMPS is recommended.
Standard L1₂ structure (space group Pm-3m, lattice parameter a≈3.57 Å). Atomic positions: Al at (0,0,0) and Ni at face centers.
